Other areas on this side: price behaviour.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 7 points in favour and 5 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 53 of 100. The side that carries most weight is growth. That gives an educational rating of Hold with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
